acceleration.method: Unmasked renderer identifies a GPU, excludes known software renderers, and CDP reports WebGL enabled

method.inputGuard: Trusted page wheel/key/pointer/touch input invalidates warm-up and capture. Fit all is invoked once before warm-up; growth/Reorganize preserve that pose. Steady captures reject layout redraws.
method.frameIntervals: Unclamped requestAnimationFrame timestamp deltas; browser frame cadence, not isolated CPU/GPU render duration
method.resourceMetrics: Existing onRenderMetrics buckets sampled every 30 rendered frames; first bucket per capture discarded because it may cross the capture boundary
method.textureBytes: Estimated source texture bytes only; excludes shadow maps, framebuffers and driver allocations
method.actionTiming: DOM click dispatch timing only; synchronous layout/rebuild stalls are included in raw frame intervals
method.percentiles: Median uses the middle value/pair; p95 uses nearest rank. Aggregate pools raw intervals across repetitions.
method.limitations: Benchmark fixtures render working agents and stationary assigned/queued tasks. This does not benchmark a live host or all possible task traffic.
